latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release — create and share personalized happy birthday videos from your photos or clips.

- Combine photos or video clips (JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV up to 200MB) into a 1080p birthday video, processed via cloud GPU in 30–60 seconds.
- Automated setup with cloud video backend, including anonymous token and session management.
- Supports uploading, editing, previewing, and exporting to MP4; add names, messages, and background music for a personal touch.
- Clear error handling and helpful feedback on upload/credit/session issues.
- Simple commands for export, upload, credit balance, and workflow status.
- No installation required; all rendering and editing happen remotely.
